responses.demo_ai_experience: I've used many of the major AI company models (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT), but mainly recreationally. I took a few beginner coding classes for a Computer Science degree, but switched to something else.  So as far as coding is concerned my experience is beginner level, but that was 10+ years ago.
